title: Intent Router — Routing Decision Contract
description: Machine-checkable form of one intent-router decision (TESS-VISION-AND-BUILD-SPEC.html Phase 1 Epic E1, 'Routing decision logged to state/ with rationale', generalized here to a component-local decision log since this component ships independent of any one deployment's state/ conventions). Deliberately NOT placed under core/contracts/ — this is this component's OWN local contract, validated by intent_router.schema_check (a minimal, dependency-free validator), never by tessctl. Every field intent_router.types.RoutingDecision.to_log_record() emits is described below; additionalProperties:false means a code change that adds an undocumented field fails validation loudly rather than silently drifting from this contract.

decision_id.description: Opaque unique id for this decision (intent_router.types.new_decision_id() — a uuid4 hex string).

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp with a 'Z' suffix, same convention core/contracts/mission.schema.json uses for created_at.

input_excerpt.description: The first 280 characters of the freeform input that was routed. A rationale excerpt, not a durable transcript store.

ambiguous.description: True if this record represents a still-ambiguous decision awaiting one clarifying answer; false for a confident (or forced) final decision.

route_id.description: The chosen (or, if ambiguous, the leading candidate) route id from the routing table.

entry_command.description: The internal command string the route names (e.g. '/founder-mode') — deployment-specific, not an enum.

orchestrator.description: The orchestrator name the route names, or null for a non-orchestrator command.

outcome_type.description: Verbatim copy of core/contracts/crew-plan.schema.json's outcome_type enum.

confidence.description: The leading candidate's normalized confidence score, 0..1.

matched_signals.description: Keywords, shared-example evidence, or external-signal markers that drove the score — the 'why' half of the narration.

runner_up_route_id.description: The second-ranked candidate's route id, if any — present so an ambiguous record's rationale is fully reconstructible from the log alone.

clarifying_question.description: Set only when ambiguous:true. The ONE clarifying question asked (epic: 'one clarifying question max').

assumption_stated.description: Set only when a decision was forced past what would otherwise have been ambiguous (epic: '...then route with stated assumption').

crew_plan_sketch.description: The first-cut crew-plan sketch (intent_router.crew_plan_sketch.build_sketch output) for a confident/forced decision; null while ambiguous.

narration.description: The human-readable 'here's what I'm doing and why' text (intent_router.narrate.narrate output).

mission_id.description: A mission id, either caller-supplied (e.g. from a real mission ledger) or the component's own fallback slug.

$comment: Minimal-validator keyword subset supported by intent_router.schema_check: type, enum, properties, required, additionalProperties, items. Mirrors (in spirit, not in code) the same 'minimal-validator keyword subset' convention core/contracts/*.schema.json's own trailing $comment documents, without importing that engine.
